voice.name: Brian - Deep, Resonant and Comforting
voice.why: Bruno runs the crew at Coalman's Brow: big, slow and sure of himself. Brian is a deep, resonant American baritone, a long way from the mill foreman's lighter laid-back drawl and from every islander voice already cast.

greet.text: Bruno. I run the crew at Coalman's Brow. Swing a pick, keep your head down, and the mine will notice you.

next_top.text: You have seen every door this mine has. The rest is just coal, friend.

next_02.text: Next up, level 2. Coal face permit: cut coal with a pick. Keep swinging.

next_03.text: Next up, level 3. Copper seam permit: cut copper ore. Keep swinging.

next_04.text: Next up, level 4. Iron seam permit: mine iron. Keep swinging.

next_05.text: Next up, level 5. Seasoned miner license: cut any ore twice as fast. Keep swinging.

next_06.text: Next up, level 6. Gold seam permit: cut gold ore. Keep swinging.

next_10.text: Next up, level 10. First perk: pick Double yield or Swift hands at the labor office. Keep swinging.

next_20.text: Next up, level 20. Second perk: Light touch and Good word join the choices at the labor office. Keep swinging.

replies.next: What does my level open next?
